_about: Public keys HID-Fi releases are signed with (ECDSA P-256, uncompressed). The private keys never enter this repository: the primary is on the owner's Mac (~/.hidfi-release), the backup is kept offline. The firmware (hid_fi/ota.h OTA_RELEASE_KEYS) and the Companion (hidfi-core ota.rs RELEASE_KEYS) embed exactly these, in this order - tests/static/test_release_keys.py holds them together. Added 2026-10-28.

macos_signing.subject: CN=HID-Fi Release (macOS), O=HID-Fi
macos_signing.about: The Companion's macOS app is signed with this certificate (tools/sign_mac_release.sh) so macOS keeps its permissions across updates. Private key: the release folder, never the repo.
